about: The official files gamescan/library_hashes.py is built from besides those of tools/manifest.json (tools/build_library_hashes.py --register): jQuery from its own CDN, SDL2 and OpenAL Soft from their GitHub releases - each only with the SHA-256 its publisher states. Used with: python tools/fetch.py --manifest tools/manifest_libraries.json
